'''Hajibala Ibrahim oglu Abutalybov''' ({{langx|az|Hacıbala İbrahim oğlu Abutalıbov}}, born 13 May 1944) is an Azerbaijani politician. He was Mayor of [[Baku]] between 2001 and 2018 and [[Deputy Prime Minister of Azerbaijan|deputy prime minister of Azerbaijan]] from 2018 to October 2019.

== Early life and education ==
Abutalybov was born in [[Türkmenbaşy, Turkmenistan|Kyzyl-Su]], Turkmenistan. He graduated from [[Azerbaijan State University]] with a degree in [[Physics]] in 1965. 
In 1969, he was enrolled in post graduate program at [[Ioffe Institute|Ioffe Physical-Technical Institute]] of the Russian Academy of Sciences in [[Saint Petersburg]], Russia. In 1976, he received his PhD and defended his doctoral desertation in 1987.<ref>[http://www.bakucity.az/main/index_en.html The Executive Power of Baku City. Head of BCEP] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120814222707/http://www.bakucity.az/main/index_en.html |date=August 14, 2012 }}</ref>

== Career ==
Abutalybov served as the head of the laboratory at Physics Department of [[Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences]] in 1995.
Same year, he was appointed the Head of the Executive Power of [[Suraxanı raion|Surakhani]] district of Baku which he held until 1999.<ref>{{cite news
 | url=http://www.hri.org/news/balkans/rferl/2001/01-02-01.rferl.html
 | title=AZERBAIJANI PRESIDENT NAMES NEW BAKU MAYOR
 | publisher=RFE/RL
 | date=February 1, 2001
 | volume=5
 | issue=22
 | accessdate=March 5, 2010
 | archive-date=June 5, 2011
 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110605044357/http://www.hri.org/news/balkans/rferl/2001/01-02-01.rferl.html
 | url-status=dead
 }}</ref> In 2000, he was appointed [[Deputy Prime Minister of Azerbaijan]].

Abutalybov served as Mayor of Baku for 17 years, between 30 January 2001 and 2018.<ref>[http://www.russia-on-line.com/assairada.html AssA-Irada Agency periodicals] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080828081135/http://www.russia-on-line.com/assairada.html |date=August 28, 2008 }}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Abutalybov is married and has two sons.
